card.name: Words introducing an open question clause
card.fires_on: Words that open an indirect or direct question or a hypothetical, such as whether, how, if, there is, after verbs like see, find, ask. Often in talk of Mars exploration or rhetorical questions.

modes.label: whether after see/find
modes.description: The word whether introduces what a mission or study will find out.
modes.example: The primary goal of the $2.5 billion mission is to see<< whether>> cold, dry, barren Mars might have

modes.label: question openers
modes.description: How or there starting a direct question.
modes.example: Rosemarie Kuptana asks: "<<How>> can we prepare ourselves for such unpredictability

modes.label: conditional linking words
modes.description: If or is in a clause about whether something exists.
modes.example: Scientists said if there<< is>> any place on Mars that might have been
